title: Calm
note: A shell theme for long sessions: soft lines, a gentle lift for what floats, moderate rounding, colour kept for meaning.

mint-25: a paler tint of mint than mint-50, behind a success message
red-25: a paler tint of red than red-50, behind an error message
amber-25: a paler tint of the warning colour, behind a warning message
red-950: a deep shade of red-ink, an opaque error surface on dark
amber-950: a deep shade of the warning colour, an opaque warning surface on dark

css: all (radius): split the scale by role. Add radius.control for button, icon-button, text-field, text-area, select, combobox, date-picker, date-range-picker, time-picker, segment, pagination, menu-item, option and tree-item; keep radius.md for surfaces (card, alert, accordion-item, listbox, tree, tab, progress, skeleton) and radius.lg for what floats. Calm would then set control 8px, surface 6px, floating 14px. Today 8px on a button forces 8px on a card.

menu, select, listbox, toast, tab (radius): stop multiplying. menu .panel and select .listbox use calc(radius.md * 2), listbox calc(radius.md * 1.25), toast calc(radius.lg * 1.33), tab calc(radius.md + 2px). Read radius.lg for the floating panels and radius.md for listbox and tab, so a dialog (12px) and a menu (16px) no longer disagree.

text-field, text-area, select, combobox, date-picker, date-range-picker, time-picker: read the field tokens. .control-frame background is var(--_surface-page); make it var(--violet-color-field-background), and var(--violet-color-field-background-readonly) when read-only. Text from color.field.text, placeholder from color.field.placeholder (now --_text-muted), the focused edge from color.field.border.focus. No component reads these five ids, so a theme cannot tint a field.

text-field and the other fields (filled appearance): add appearance="filled": background color.field.background (calm would set @ink/0.05 in light, @paper/0.07 in dark), border 1px solid transparent at rest, no shadow.control; on hover border-color color.field.border; on focus the 2px ring as now. To stay findable without a 3:1 edge: keep the label above and the value or placeholder at 4.5:1, draw a 1px color.field.border line on the block-end edge only (inset 0 -1px 0 box-shadow, so the radius is kept), and restore the full border under prefers-contrast: more, the high-contrast preset and forced colours. Keep outline as the default until the owner accepts that trade.

segmented-control: .group border-radius reads --_radius-lg, which violetFieldTokenDefaults never defines, so the track is square around rounded segments. Define it, then draw the control as a tinted track with a raised thumb: .group { border: 0; padding: 2px; background: color.surface.subtle; box-shadow: none; border-radius: calc(radius.control + 2px) } and :host([checked]) .button { background: color.surface.highlight; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: shadow.control; border-radius: radius.control }.

button, text-field, text-area, select: remove the movement. .control:hover { transform: translateY(-1px) } on button and the translateY on .control-frame:focus-within make controls shift under the pointer and the caret. Keep the colour change and shadow.control; a shell that recedes should not move its chrome.

slider, range-slider: .thumb takes shadow.floating, a panel's shadow, and a border of color.border.subtle on a page-coloured fill. Use box-shadow: shadow.control and border: 1px solid color.border.strong, so the thumb meets 3:1 and the floating shadow can be sized for dialogs.

option: the selected surface is color-mix(color.state.success.background 58%, transparent) and its border color.state.success.foreground. Read color.surface.selected and color.control.selected.border: a chosen row is not a success message, and the two should be tunable apart.
calendar: .day-button.selected uses color.state.success.foreground as its fill and a literal white for the numeral. Use color.control.selected.background and color.control.selected.foreground.

tab: add a pill appearance for use inside panels: selected tab { background: color.surface.subtle; border-radius: radius.control; color: color.text.primary; font-weight: 500 }, no .indicator, and no border-block-end on the tablist. Keep the underline appearance for page-level tabs.

skeleton, tab, tree-item: remove literal white. skeleton --_skeleton-highlight is color-mix(white 68%, card), tab --_tab-hover color-mix(subtle 42%, white), tree-item selected row color-mix(subtle 76%, white). On dark they flash light grey. Mix with color.surface.highlight instead.

field and action token defaults: under (pointer: fine) only the body size should drop 1px. --_type-label-size-compact and --_type-caption-size-compact give 11px labels and 10px help text on a desktop, which is small for a day's work.

field and action token defaults: under (pointer: fine) the auto target is size.target.compact. Give desktop controls their own id (size.target.control, 28px in calm) so a theme can size buttons and fields without moving the 24px floor Loam's status bar is built on. Calm sets size.target.compact to 28px to show the result.

toast, snackbar: the toned surface is color-mix(state background 78%, card). With a translucent state background (the base dark preset) the toast shows the page through it. Mix over color.surface.floating, or state that state backgrounds must be opaque.

alert, approval-card: the icon disc is tinted from the state colour and the surface is tinted too. Drop the surface tint for the info tone only if a quieter stack is wanted; no change needed for calm.
button (primary as a pill): not recommended. badge, chat-suggestions and persona are already fully round; a round primary button would read as a chip.
